players.name: Julian Lewis
players.stats: 2026: 733 passing yards, 6 TD, 2 INT in four games.
players.why: Benched for Isaac Wilson after a disappointing season; The Athletic says the same goes for Lewis as for other quarterbacks who will likely need a new school.

players.name: Faizon Brandon
players.elig: Not established in the cited reporting

players.name: Demond Williams Jr.
players.elig: Not established in the cited reporting
players.stats: No 2026 season-total statistical line provided in the cited report.

players.name: Malik Washington
players.stats: Through 7 games: 1,615 passing yards, 9 TD, 6 INT.
players.why: A reporter said Washington stopped short of recommitting after Mike Locksley’s firing; he said he was focused on finishing the season. The report identified him as a player who could attract portal interest, but did not report an intent to transfer.

players.name: Sidney Stewart
players.stats: Through 7 games: 26 tackles, 2 sacks, 2 forced fumbles; recorded 7 sacks and 10.5 TFL in 2025.
players.why: Stewart acknowledged that Locksley’s departure would make him reconsider his options. The reporter said neither he nor Washington had indicated an intent to enter the portal.

players.name: Keenan Jackson
players.why: A local report listed Jackson among possible transfer targets if he makes himself available; ESPN said retaining him should be a priority after Dave Doeren’s firing. Neither source reported a current intent to enter the portal.

players.name: Braden Atkinson
players.elig: Not established in the cited reporting
players.stats: 2,604 passing yards, 24 TD, 2 INT through the cited midseason report.
players.why: FCS-to-FBS production could attract Power Four interest; reporting also says Oregon State will prioritize retention. This is a potential upward-mobility case, not a reported desire to leave.

players.name: Dylan Riley
players.stats: 835 rushing yards; fourth in FBS at the time of the report. Had a career-best 206-yard game against Memphis and three runs of 70-plus yards.
players.why: Yahoo said Power Four teams able to offer him a lead-back role could have a strong pitch, as he shares carries at Boise State.

players.name: CJ Bailey
players.stats: Through 7 games: 1,763 passing yards, 11 passing TD; career totals cited by ESPN: 7,952 total yards and 66 total TD since 2024.
players.why: ESPN said the coaching change could bring tampering and that Bailey would have good options if he entered the portal. He had previously turned down portal interest and re-signed with NC State; no current intent to leave was reported.
